text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognising images, and making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks. Today, AI is used in many areas of daily life, such as voice assistants, online shopping, social media, and navigation apps. It helps us work faster and solve problems more easily.
